name: Yukisou no Neige
source:
A short love suspense novel game about a man who has killed people without thinking and a girl who is alone in her whole life.

---- Do you remember my family?

Avels, an assassin, meets a girl named "Neige" while on vacation and gradually becomes attracted to her as he spends casual days with her.

(----) With this girl, I could be just a man.

Tired of killing people, Avels wants to lead a peaceful life, but...

A short romantic suspense novel about an inevitable fate.

(Translated from NovelGame page)
translation:
一款关于一个杀人不眨眼的男人和一个一生孤独的女孩的短篇爱情悬疑小说游戏。

----你还记得我的家人吗？

刺客阿维尔斯在度假时遇见了名叫“奈吉”的女孩，并在与她度过休闲时光的过程中逐渐被她吸引。

(----) 有了这个女孩，我就可以只是个男人了。

阿维尔斯厌倦了杀人，想要过上平静的生活，但是……

一部关于不可避免的命运的短篇浪漫悬疑小说。

（摘自NovelGame页面）
